decisions.reason: This illuminated candle arch line has several models, sits close to the firm's core offer and was shown on the home page, so the investment and visible commitment favour keeping it.
This single pyramid model is core craft work featured on the home page, so dropping it would undo a visible commitment, although less was invested in it than in a full line.

Presented as the flagship of the firm's new direction and built as a multi-model line, this music box carries heavy investment and public commitment, and any weak results can be blamed on a temporary market-entry phase.
Although distant from the core offer and only mentioned on the website, this motif platform supports the flagship music box system, so the firm keeps it to justify that direction.
This Christmas platform has a low profile and little invested in it, but it is tied to the flagship music box and fits the seasonal range, so the firm likely keeps it.
This Dresden-themed pyramid builds on the firm's established craft and was shown on the home page, so its visibility and fit with the core argue for keeping it.
